speaker: ICE
line: We aren't brothers, Sergei. And your credit just expired.

speaker: ICE
line: Crates loaded in the trunk. Armor-piercing tungsten-core 7.62. Gohan and Guess have what they need.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Lifeinvader annex. Roof first, then both guards go down quiet. Nobody needs to die for a camera archive.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Two guards between me and the server room. Stun gun first; the thermal pulse finds them for me.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Worm installed. Camera archive access is ours. Getting out before IT traces the connection.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Slip down the fire escape before internal IT notices the packet spike. Clean and invisible.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Twin-turbo revving at 7,000 RPM, two-step popping
line: Marabunta thinks their tuned Elegy has the top end. They don't know who is behind this wheel.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Slipstream Reflex activated, slow-mo engine roar
line: Three laps. KJ, keep an eye on their line.

speaker: RIVAL RACER
line: We lost the race! Shoot his tires before he leaves!

speaker: GUESS
line: They pulled guns after losing. I can stop them or get the coupe back to the finish.

speaker: GUESS
line: Checkered flag! Title is in my pocket and the racing transmission is loaded on the truck.

speaker: ICE
direction: Wind howling through scope, breathing slow
line: Two Aegis marksmen watching the quarry road. I'll take the overlook and identify both positions.

speaker: ICE
line: One down. The other still has a sightline on the road. Can't leave him there.

speaker: ICE
line: Both down. Radios recovered. Gohan can listen for patrol calls; we'll still have to watch the road.
trigger: Both marksmen eliminated and both radios collected

speaker: GOHAN
line: Swamp's dark enough to hide a boat. Going in quiet. I'll call when I find the buoy.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Buoy located. Fitting the interceptor at the service harness. Keep this channel open.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Signal locked. We can read the flight traffic this buoy relays. Coming back to the pickup.

speaker: GUESS
line: Aviation fuel, full load. Easy on the throttle. This thing only has to arrive in one piece.

speaker: GUESS
line: Cartel bikes behind me! Gohan, keep the airfield gate clear.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Flooring pedal, swerving into lead bike
line: Through the canyon. Still got the load. I'm taking the next bend slow, whether they like it or not.

speaker: GUESS
line: Tanker at McKenzie, intact. Set this fuel aside for the rig operation.

speaker: ICE
line: Fifteen years ago Sterling got my whole squad ambushed in Kandahar for a five-hundred-thousand-dollar kickback. Tonight I settle the ledger.

speaker: ICE
direction: Breaching suite doors with suppressed assault rifle
line: Four executive bodyguards in the foyer-neutralized.

speaker: STERLING
line: Vance! You're a ghost! That was fifteen years ago in the desert!

speaker: ICE
line: I didn't forget a single name on those dog tags, Sterling. Look at me.

speaker: ICE
line: Debt settled. The past is buried. Now we finish Aegis in Los Santos.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Vanderbilt & Cole. The suits who doctored the ledgers and handed my name to the feds fifteen years ago. Payback time.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Bypassing their biometric vault lock. Downloading sixty gigabytes of blackmail files.

speaker: GOHAN
line: Chemical thermite strips armed along every filing cabinet. In sixty seconds, their entire corrupt history is ash.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Watching flames reflect in glass window
line: The evidence proving they framed me is out. Clearing my name comes next. First, Ice and Guess need me.

speaker: GUESS
line: The foreign captain wants this hypercar on his cargo deck before dawn, or the escape passports don't get stamped. Guess never fails a delivery.

speaker: GUESS
line: LSPD SWAT cruisers setting up spiked roadblocks on the bridge! Slipstream Reflex engaged!

speaker: GUESS
direction: Launching car off construction ramp over police cruiser
line: Flying over the blockade! Eat my exhaust!

speaker: GUESS
line: Car driven straight into the shipping container! Container door locked! Passports and sea passage secured for the whole crew!
